issues.title: Hurricane Isaias strengthens to Category 1; No threat to Dominican Republic
issues.title_en: Hurricane Isaias strengthens to Category 1; No threat to Dominican Republic
issues.summary: Santo Domingo.- Hurricane Isaias strengthened Thursday as it moved through the Gulf of Mexico, while the Dominican Republic remains outside the storm’s projected path and faces no direct threat from the system. […]
